definitions.explanation: A cooking method where ingredients are slowly simmered in a broth flavored with miso paste, producing rich, savory dishes.

examples.japanese: {鯖|さば}の{味噌煮|みそに}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made mackerel simmered in miso.

examples.japanese: {味噌煮|みそに}は{白|しろ}ごはんによく{合|あ}う。
examples.english: Miso-simmered dishes go well with white rice.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{鯖|さば}の{味噌煮|みそに}は、{味噌|みそ}の{甘|あま}みと{生姜|しょうが}の{香|かお}りが{絶妙|ぜつみょう}だった。
examples.english: My grandmother's miso-simmered mackerel had a perfect blend of miso sweetness and ginger fragrance.

notes:
A compound of {味噌|みそ} (miso paste) and {煮|に} (simmering). {鯖|さば}の{味噌煮|みそに} (miso-simmered mackerel) is one of the most iconic Japanese home-cooking dishes. The miso helps mask the fishy smell while adding depth and richness. Also commonly used with {大根|だいこん} (daikon) and other vegetables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鯖|さば}の{味噌煮|みそに}: mackerel simmered in miso
- {大根|だいこん}の{味噌煮|みそに}: daikon simmered in miso
- {味噌煮込|みそにこ}み: miso-stewed (longer cooking variant)
- {味噌煮|みそに}にする: to simmer in miso

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {煮付|につ}け: simmered in soy-based broth — uses soy sauce instead of miso
- {甘露煮|かんろに}: candied/simmered in sweet syrup — sweeter preparation
- {味噌汁|みそしる}: miso soup — a soup, not a simmered dish
- {味噌煮込|みそにこ}みうどん: miso-stewed udon — a Nagoya specialty
